title: Knife Creek Block compartments and planned harvest units: area table
source_document: Alex Fraser Research Forest Management and Working Plan #3 (January 1, 2007), Appendix 9
transcription: Manual transcription from the published map table; checked against a 250 dpi render and reconciled to the printed totals.
notes: This is a public planning-map table, not a legal spatial layer.
The map on page 162 is schematic: it has a north arrow and scale bar but no coordinate grid. It was not georeferenced for this table.
Compartment rows KC01-KC11 are MDWR (mule-deer winter range) management units; RD05 is a reserve; RD06 and RD07 are OGMAs.
The printed total net area is 3162.3 ha. Table 32 of the same plan states 3117 ha net productive area; both are recorded and are not forced to agree.
The SUP legal boundary is 3533.1341 ha; the plan table gross area is 3485.6 ha. Different vintages/boundaries; record, do not reconcile silently.
